fullPassage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

det.tip: correspond(상응하다, 동사) → corresponding(상응하는, 형용사) → correspondence(서신, 명사)

questions.passage: One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it __________ (mild), not a very good friend.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

"...to put it __________(mild), not a very good friend." (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: mild → mildly(완곡하게): 동사 put을 수식하는 부사가 필요 (to put it mildly = 완곡하게 말하면)
det.analysis: mild(온화한, 형용사) → mildly(완곡하게, 부사): 동사 put을 수식하므로 부사형 필요
det.tip: mild(온화한, 형용사) → mildly(완곡하게, 부사) / to put it mildly = 완곡하게 말해서

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not __________. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 친구에게 받을 것만 생각하고 빚진 것은 생각하지 않는 사람은, 완곡하게 말해, ________이 아니다 → 아주 좋은 친구(a very good friend)
det.analysis:
❌ ① a corresponding set of obligations(상응하는 의무): 'not a corresponding set of obligations'는 문맥상 비논리적
✅ ② a very good friend(아주 좋은 친구): 친구 관계의 비유에서 적절한 결론 ←정답
❌ ③ a moment's thought(잠깐의 생각): 'not a moment's thought'는 앞 구문과 중복되며 결론이 안 됨
❌ ④ every other area of human life(삶의 다른 영역): 구문 구조상 연결 불가
det.tip: 이 문장은 팬-선수 관계를 친구 관계에 비유한 것이므로 friend가 적절

ch: every other area of human life

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선수가 자신에게 빚진 것에 대해 자신 있게 의견을 말하면서도 더 나은 팬이 되려는 생각은 하지 않는 팬은 ________을 이행하지 않는 것이다 → 자기 몫의 거래(their end of the bargain)
det.analysis:
❌ ① a moment's thought(잠깐의 생각): 'hardly fulfilling a moment's thought'는 구문 구조상 연결 불가
❌ ② every other area of human life(삶의 다른 영역): fulfilling과 연결 시 비논리적
✅ ③ their end of the bargain(자기 몫의 약속): 의무 이행이라는 결론에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ the special rights they possess(그들이 가진 특별한 권리): 권리를 '이행'한다는 표현은 어색
det.tip: fulfill one's end of the bargain = 약속에서 자기 몫을 이행하다 / bargain = 거래, 약속
